headline: Business Spotlight: Pure Energy Project Ltd
paragraph: Old Oak Common residents wrestling with a temperamental boiler or an overdue bathroom refit now have a trusted name on their doorstep. Pure Energy Project Ltd, based on Braemar Avenue in NW10, brings Gas Safe-registered plumbing and heating expertise to the neighbourhood — from powerflushing radiators and full central-heating installs to pipework alterations and kitchen or bathroom plumbing. Their team also covers electrical work through NICEIC-registered engineers, and the whole operation is fully insured for gas, plumbing and electrical work, backed by a two-year guarantee on labour. Whether it's a leaking radiator on a wet Tuesday or planning a full heating system redesign, it's reassuring to have certified local tradespeople covering Old Oak Common out to Chiswick. Find Pure Energy Project Ltd in our business directory, or call 07843 676 480.
